title: Galle Gallants Crowned LPL 2026 Champions
byline: Galle Gallants secured their maiden Lanka Premier League (LPL) title with a convincing five-wicket victory over Jaffna Kings in a low-scoring final at the R. Premadasa International Cricket Stadium in Colombo.

title: British Columbia district declares state of emergency, issues evacuation orders as wildfire rages
byline: A state of emergency was declared by the district of Summerland, British Columbia, early Saturday as a fast-moving wildfire ​swept through western Canada, forcing thousands of residents to ‌evacuate their homes.

title: India hands over Bailey Bridges weighing over 250 MT to Sri Lanka
byline: India has handed over another consignment of Bailey Bridges, weighing more than 250 metric tonnes, to Sri Lanka as part of its ongoing assistance to the country.

title: SriLankan Airlines resumes Colombo–Kuwait flights
byline: SriLankan Airlines has resumed flights between Colombo and Kuwait, offering six services per week.

title: Fifa criticises campaign to oust president Infantino
byline: Fifa has strongly criticised what it calls a ’’concerted and ongoing effort’’ to ’’undermine’’ the organisation and its president Gianni Infantino.

title: Two arrested over viral cat cruelty incident in Thalathuoya
byline: Two suspects have been arrested by the Thalathuoya Police in connection with an alleged act of cruelty against a cat, footage of which recently went viral on social media.

title: Four arrested over hand grenade attack on house in Ratmalana
byline: Four suspects have been arrested in connection with a hand grenade attack on a house in Ratmalana, Mount Lavinia.

title: Kusal Mendis elected first President of Sri Lanka Professional Cricketers’ Association
byline: Sri Lanka limited-overs captain Kusal Mendis has been elected the first President of the newly established Sri Lanka Professional Cricketers’ Association (SLPCA).

title: Controversy erupts at ‘Battle of the Queens’ cricket encounter
byline: The annual “Battle of the Queens” one-day cricket encounter between Princess of Wales’ College, Moratuwa, and Yasodhara Devi Balika Vidyalaya, Colombo, ended amid controversy at De Soysa Stadium in Moratuwa yesterday.

title: Ex-President Joe Biden’s cancer has spread, is very painful, son says
byline: Former U.S. President Joe Biden’s prostate cancer has spread beyond his bones and is ​very painful, his son, Hunter Biden, said in ‌an interview with the BBC.

title: Four killed in helicopter crash in Brazil’s Rio de Janeiro
byline: At least four people have been killed in a helicopter crash in the Brazilian city of Rio de Janeiro, according to a statement from the Colombian consul in the country.

title: Tunisian tourist dies after being swept away while surfing
byline: A 21-year-old Tunisian tourist who went missing after being swept away by a rip current while surfing off the Weligama coast has been found dead.

title: Mojtaba seen for the 1st time since war:Iran’s supreme leader appears to be in normal health; Israeli media claimed he is in ’critical condition’
byline: Iran has released a video of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. In the video, which is his first public appearance since the war, Khamenei is seen talking to people seated on the ground. The video has been released at a time when several reports have emerged about his health.

title: Sri Lanka’s foreign remittances surpass US$5 Billion in first seven months
byline: Sri Lanka’s foreign remittances from overseas workers have surpassed US$5 billion during the first seven months of 2026, according to data released by the Central Bank of Sri Lanka.

byline: Former U.S. President Joe Biden’s prostate cancer has spread beyond his bones and is ​very painful, his son, Hunter Biden, said in ‌an interview with the BBC.

title: Three Hettipola motorcycle dealers fined for overcharging
byline: Three motorcycle dealers in Hettipola have been fined by the Hettipola Magistrate’s Court for selling motorcycles above the official dealer prices and failing to display prices, following raids conducted by the Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA).

title: Police bust counterfeit currency operation in Kotte
byline: The Western Province South Crimes Division has arrested a 53-year-old man over the alleged production of counterfeit currency at a communication centre in Kotte, Mirihana.

title: Indigenous communities to receive legal identification under new measures
byline: Legal identification for Sri Lanka’s Indigenous communities will be introduced under new measures announced by Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, as the Government moves ahead with long-awaited legislation to protect their rights and traditional way of life.

title: Israel rejects Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
byline: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has rejected US President Donald Trump’s 15-point plan for Gaza, stating that no military pull-out will happen until Hamas is ’’genuinely’’ disarmed.
